title: holt.config.json
description: Configuration for holt, the local server for the holt Chrome extension. Every key is optional. This schema is for editor autocomplete only; the server validates the file itself.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor support.

outputDir.description: Directory (relative to the project root) where session folders are written. If holt creates it, it adds a .gitignore so sessions are not committed by default.

port.description: Port for the standalone server (`npx holt`). Ignored by the Vite plugin, which uses Vite's port.

host.description: Interface the standalone server binds to. Keep this on loopback: the server writes files to disk. A non-loopback host requires a token, and the server refuses to start without one.

token.description: Optional shared secret. When set, the extension must send it in the x-holt-token header. Enter the same value in the extension settings. Required for any request from another machine.

maxUploadBytes.description: Maximum size of a single uploaded screenshot or recording, in bytes. Default 200 MiB.

sessionTitle.description: Default title (the H1 of notes.md) for new sessions.

projectName.description: Name the extension shows for this project, so you can tell several running servers apart. Default: the "name" field of package.json in the project root, else the root directory's name. At most 100 characters, no control characters.

allowedOrigins.description: Extra web origins allowed to call the API, e.g. "http://localhost:3000". chrome-extension:// origins are always allowed. Exact origins only: no wildcards, paths, or trailing slashes.

allowedExtensionIds.description: Chrome extension IDs allowed to call the API (32 letters a-p, as shown on chrome://extensions). Empty allows any chrome-extension:// origin; set it to pin holt to your installed copy of the extension.
